plan.summary: Remove automatic pre-save copy at shared draft boundaries, retain quiet dirty state and actionable blockers, then enforce the distinction with focused anti-drift coverage and completion gates.

risks: A broad removal could accidentally hide validation or a blocker shown only after a user action.
Stale success or informational copy could remain visible after a later draft edit unless the central edit boundary clears it.
The refinement is not security relevant because it changes presentation only; security/readiness blockers must remain inline.
research.summary: System Compose centralizes draft-change feedback through commitDraft/applyDraftHistory, so clearing notices at that boundary removes property, styling, add/remove/move, connection, undo/redo, and layout reminders without changing draft semantics. Additional automatic pre-save copy is isolated to asset customization, asset studio, and composition preview presentation.
